fato_historico: 2011: Arab Spring: After 11 months of protests in Yemen, Yemeni president Ali Abdullah Saleh signs a deal to transfer power to the vice president, in exchange for legal immunity.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound shift, much like a long-awaited transition of authority within your own spirit. As old patterns release their grip, consider this a graceful moment to transfer your focus toward future growth. You might feel a gentle surge of renewal, encouraging you to step into a new chapter with confidence and deep emotional clarity.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the wisdom to let go and gracefully begin again.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic energy of change and personal evolution.
conselho: Embrace the release of outdated burdens to invite fresh luck into your life.
